title: Running Commentary on Torah 57 — Eimasai Ben David Ba
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 57 — אימתי בן דוד בא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. 19-segment coarse structure preserves Rabbeinu's ois-marking (א–ח) plus Reb Nosson's substantial editorial note in the middle (seg 17) about Rabbeinu's intentional erasures. Torah 57 decodes the Sanhedrin-98a mishnah of R' Yosei ben Kisma ('when will Ben David come? When this gate falls and is built, falls and is built, falls...') as the *three falls of the sha'ar of Aram = sha'ar d'sitra achra*, corresponding to (1) chizuk emunas chachamim via neder (Ois א-ב), (2) hisnotzetzus ohros avos (Ois ג), (3) oneg Shabbos + shalom via tzedakah (Ois ד-ח). The torah threads together: malach-per-dibbur + yadayim of malach + 28 parkim of dibbur (Yoma 75a); neder=Yaakov=pele that heals the pele of chochmas-chachamav-to'vad; shin-bas wordplay on Shabbos; kaveid-ka'as-Esav-Edom subdued by tzom; shalom-with-peh vs shalom-without-peh (chametz=cheis vs matzah=hei); the bkm-acronym of the avos = b'shemen kodshi m'shach'tiv. Written in Rabbeinu's own leshon (inclusio seg 3 + end of seg 16).
